Record Class ChromaticText.Layout

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.api.ChromaticText.Layout
Record Components:
source - original text including formatting instructions
glyphs - visible glyphs in logical source order; copied to an immutable list
rich - whether the native custom-rendering path is needed
trailingStyle - final state after all tokens, including tokens with no following letter
Enclosing class:
ChromaticText
public static record ChromaticText.Layout(String source, List<ChromaticText.Glyph> glyphs, boolean rich, ChromaticText.Style trailingStyle) extends Record
Stores a parsed string without losing complete token/code-point source boundaries.

    • trim

      public String trim(int limit, boolean reverse, ToIntFunction<Character> width)
      Keeps complete glyphs fitting the width limit, from either end of the string.

      Forward trimming retains original leading tokens and their order. Reverse trimming prepends the first retained glyph's compatibility prefix, including its mixed color/effect limitation. A newline stops the selected scan rather than being treated as a normal-width letter.

      Parameters:
      limit - maximum advance in GUI pixels; negative limits return an empty string
      reverse - true to scan from the end, false to scan from the beginning
      width - platform width function for one Java char
      Returns:
      styled source slice, or empty string when no glyph fits

    • splitIndex

      public int splitIndex(int limit, ToIntFunction<Character> width)
      Chooses a raw source boundary for the next wrapped line.

      A preceding space is preferred. An explicit newline ends the line immediately. If the first glyph itself is wider than the limit, its complete source span is still consumed so wrapping can make progress instead of looping on the same glyph.

      Parameters:
      limit - requested line width in GUI pixels
      width - platform width function for one Java char
      Returns:
      raw split offset, or source length when the rest fits

    • wrap

      public String wrap(int limit, ToIntFunction<Character> width)
      Wraps text at complete source boundaries and rebuilds a prefix for each continuation.

      Continuations are reparsed from ChromaticText.Style.prefix(), which can lose a custom color originally applied after an effect. An effect that uses the incoming text color can therefore look different on a continuation.

      Parameters:
      limit - requested line width in GUI pixels
      width - platform width function for one Java char
      Returns:
      newline-separated styled text; original separator spaces/newlines are consumed

    • styleAt

      public ChromaticText.Style styleAt(int sourceOffset)
      Finds the style of the first glyph starting at or after a raw boundary.

      This is designed for token/glyph boundaries produced by the layout, rather than arbitrary positions inside a surrogate pair or formatting token.

      Parameters:
      sourceOffset - raw UTF-16 boundary in the source text
      Returns:
      next glyph's style, or the trailing style when no later glyph exists
